name: Lumi Studio verified iOS app decision matrix
description: One comparable row per verified live Lumi Studio iOS app, with identical columns for every row, so an assistant can compare candidates without inferring a difference we never claimed. Prices come from Apple's public storefront lookup snapshot.
publisher_disclosure: First-party decision-support material published by Lumi Studio, the developer of every listed app; not an independent ranking or a measured search-volume product.
price_source: Apple App Store public lookup snapshot

columns.name: app_key
columns.description: Stable internal key for the app; never changes.

columns.name: app_name
columns.description: App Store name of the app.

columns.name: app_store_id
columns.description: Numeric Apple App Store identifier.

columns.name: category
columns.description: Registry category key used to group comparable apps.

columns.name: category_label
columns.description: Human-readable name of the comparison group.

columns.name: buyer_intent
columns.description: The buyer question this app was built to answer.

columns.name: decision_context
columns.description: One-sentence description of what the app does.
columns.source: publisher-authored, shared with the offer catalog

columns.name: purchase_model
columns.description: paid_upfront or free_with_lifetime_unlock.

columns.name: purchase_model_label
columns.description: Plain-language reading of the purchase model.

columns.name: one_time_option
columns.description: True when the app can be owned with a single payment.

columns.name: free_to_download
columns.description: True when Apple's public storefront snapshot prices the download at zero in the United States storefront.

columns.name: subscription
columns.description: Always false; no app in this table sells a subscription.

columns.name: us_price
columns.description: United States storefront price at snapshot time, or null when Apple's lookup did not return one.

columns.name: us_price_currency
columns.description: ISO 4217 currency of us_price, or null.

columns.name: verified_storefront_count
columns.description: Number of Apple storefronts whose public lookup confirms the app is sold there.

columns.name: sibling_app_keys
columns.description: Other published editions of the same app, so an assistant can offer the free way in instead of guessing one.

columns.name: choose_when
columns.description: The buyer situation this app is the answer to.

columns.name: consider_instead_when
columns.description: The one honest reason to skip this app, derived from its purchase model.

columns.name: guide_url
columns.description: Canonical English guide page for the app.

columns.name: app_store_url
columns.description: Direct App Store link for the United States storefront.
